description: Defines interfaces for display and connection properties, including graphics, HDR, and colorimetry, within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace.

classes.name: IGraphicsProperties
classes.description: Interface for retrieving GPU memory information.

classes.name: IConnectionProperties
classes.description: Interface for connection-related properties and notifications, including HDCP and HDMI status.

classes.name: INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for connection property updates.

classes.name: IHDRProperties
classes.description: Interface for HDR capabilities and settings.

classes.name: IDisplayProperties
classes.description: Interface for display properties such as color space, frame rate, and colorimetry.

methods.name: TotalGpuRam
methods.description: Retrieves total GPU DRAM memory in bytes.

methods.name: FreeGpuRam
methods.description: Retrieves free GPU DRAM memory in bytes.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: IsAudioPassthrough
methods.description: Checks if audio passthrough is enabled on HDMI.

methods.name: Connected
methods.description: Checks HDMI connection status.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Gets horizontal resolution of TV.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Gets vertical resolution of TV.

methods.name: VerticalFreq
methods.description: Gets vertical frequency of display.

methods.name: EDID
methods.description: Retrieves the EDID data of the display.

methods.name: WidthInCentimeters
methods.description: Gets width of display in centimeters.

methods.name: HeightInCentimeters
methods.description: Gets height of display in centimeters.

methods.name: HDCPProtection
methods.description: Gets or sets the HDCP protection protocol.

methods.name: PortName
methods.description: Gets the name of the video output port.

methods.name: TVCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves supported HDR formats by TV.

methods.name: STBCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves supported HDR formats by STB.

methods.name: HDRSetting
methods.description: Gets the current HDR format in use.

methods.name: ColorSpace
methods.description: Gets the display's colour space.

methods.name: FrameRate
methods.description: Gets the display's frame rate.

methods.name: ColourDepth
methods.description: Gets the display's colour depth.

methods.name: Colorimetry
methods.description: Gets the display's colorimetry information.

methods.name: QuantizationRange
methods.description: Gets the display's quantization range.

methods.name: EOTF
methods.description: Gets the display's electro-optical transfer function.
